The component also supports the common properties [`id`](../common-properties/#id), [`hidden`](../common-properties/#hidden), [`grid`](../grid/), and [`pageBreak`](../page-break/).

| Property                          | Type                                                                                                         | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `type`                            | `"NavigationButtons"`                                                                                        | Yes      |         | Identifies which component type this configuration represents.                                                           |
| `textResourceBindings`            | `object`                                                                                                     | No       |         | Connects component texts to text resources or expressions.                                                               |
| `textResourceBindings.back`       | `string \| expression<string>`                                                                               | No       |         | Text on the back/previous page button                                                                                    |
| `textResourceBindings.next`       | `string \| expression<string>`                                                                               | No       |         | Text on the next page button                                                                                             |
| `textResourceBindings.backToPage` | `string \| expression<string>`                                                                               | No       |         | Text on the "Back to Page" button when linkToPage/linkToComponent expression is used.                                    |
| `showBackButton`                  | `boolean`                                                                                                    | No       | `true`  | Shows two buttons (back/next) instead of just 'next'.                                                                    |
| `validateOnNext`                  | `object`                                                                                                     | No       |         |                                                                                                                          |
| `validateOnNext.page`             | `"current" \| "currentAndPrevious" \| "all"`                                                                 | Yes      |         | Which pages should be validated when the next button is clicked. Allowed values: "current", "currentAndPrevious", "all". |
| `validateOnNext.show`             | `"Schema" \| "Component" \| "Expression" \| "CustomBackend" \| "Required" \| "AllExceptRequired" \| "All"[]` | Yes      |         | List of validation types to show                                                                                         |
| `validateOnPrevious`              | `object`                                                                                                     | No       |         |                                                                                                                          |
| `validateOnPrevious.page`         | `"current" \| "currentAndPrevious" \| "all"`                                                                 | Yes      |         | Which pages should be validated when the next button is clicked. Allowed values: "current", "currentAndPrevious", "all". |
| `validateOnPrevious.show`         | `"Schema" \| "Component" \| "Expression" \| "CustomBackend" \| "Required" \| "AllExceptRequired" \| "All"[]` | Yes      |         | List of validation types to show                                                                                         |
